author: GitHub
description:
A factory isn’t defined by what it produces, but by the process that produces it. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Peli de Halleux (GitHub Next, Microsoft), Tim Mason (Marks and Spencer), and Paul Snider (Provation / Fortive) demonstrate how to build an agentic software factory using GitHub Actions and GitHub Copilot. See how a team of five engineers ships 460 pull requests a week, how Marks & Spencer fixed 77 issues in a single day with autonomous workflows, and how Provation runs auditable AI agents in regulated healthcare. Learn the architecture, governance, and central control planes required to deploy agents safely across your organization. 

Speakers:
Peli de Halleux, Agentic Engineer, GitHub Next, Microsoft
Tim Mason, Principal Engineer, Marks and Spencer
Paul Snider, CTO, Provation/Fortive

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AArI948SDz8&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU
